QUOTE: Exceptions must not cross into C. The stream observer's trampoline wraps the Python callable in try/except and prints the traceback to stderr. The hook path follows the same principle.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the stream observer trampoline catches exceptions and only vaguely says the hook path "follows the same principle". It never states that the hook trampoline swallows every exception and treats a failed hook as pass-through.
